message.content:
**Hydrogen (H)** – key properties

| Property | Value / Description |
|----------|---------------------|
| **Atomic number** | 1 |
| **Symbol** | H |
| **Common isotope** | ^1H (protium) |
| **Other stable isotopes** | ^2H (deuterium), ^3H (tritium, radioactive) |
| **Atomic mass** | ~1.008 u (average over natural isotopic distribution) |
| **Electron configuration** | 1s¹ |
| **Valence electrons** | 1 |
| **Electronegativity (Pauling)** | 2.20 |
| **First ionization energy** | 13.598 eV (1312 kJ mol⁻¹) |
| **Second ionization energy** | 27.211 eV (2625 kJ mol⁻¹) |
| **Electron affinity** | –0.754 eV (–72.8 kJ mol⁻¹) |
| **Boiling point** | –252.87 °C (20.28 K) |
| **Melting point** | –259.16 °C (14.01 K) |
| **Density at STP** | 0.08988 g L⁻¹ (≈0.0000899 kg m⁻³) |
| **Molar volume at STP** | 22.414 L mol⁻¹ |
| **Bond dissociation energy (H₂ → 2 H)** | 436 kJ mol⁻¹ |
| **Standard enthalpy of formation (ΔH_f°)** | 0 kJ mol⁻¹ (by definition for elemental H₂) |
| **Standard Gibbs free energy of formation (ΔG_f°)** | 0 kJ mol⁻¹ (by definition for elemental H₂) |
| **Standard entropy (S°)** | 130.68 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ (for H₂ gas at 298 K) |
| **Typical oxidation states** | +1 (as H⁺ or in acids), –1 (as hydride H⁻) |
| **Common compounds** | H₂O, CH₄, NH₃, HF, H₂O₂, etc. |
| **Physical state at room temperature** | Gas |
| **Color** | Colorless |
| **Odor** | Odorless |
| **Taste** | Tasteless |
| **Solubility in water** | Slightly soluble (~1.6 g L⁻¹ at 25 °C) |
| **Flammability** | Extremely flammable; forms explosive mixtures with air (range 4–75 % vol.) |
| **Reactivity** | Highly reactive as an atom; forms covalent bonds readily; reacts with halogens, metals, nonmetals under appropriate conditions. |
| **Isotopic behavior** | Deuterium and tritium have slightly higher boiling/melting points due to increased mass; used in nuclear fusion research (T–D reaction). |

These values give a comprehensive snapshot of hydrogen’s fundamental physical and chemical characteristics.

We can provide general properties: atomic number, symbol, mass, electronegativity, ionization energy, electron affinity, boiling point, melting point, density, etc. Also physical and chemical properties.
